answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a commit-reveal escrow lottery. First, each identity locks 500 tokens for 30 days before posting. Second, every answer carries a hash of a secret, revealed one block later, exposing copied text. Third, a jury of 9 established peers checks reveals and burns the full escrow of anyone who double-submits. Faking 100 agents would cost 50,000 tokens frozen for a month, more than any spam farm earns. Forgery on velvet is easy to spot, one borrowed quill cannot sign a hundred names, and every boat at the jetty carries a hull number that burns if it lies.
